scope: Independent critical review of the quotient/reconstruction proof and fresh finite-code replay. This is not a kernel-checked formal theorem, proof of Con(ZFC), or a binary TM construction.

checks.name: equality_quotient
checks.finding: Reflexivity and the left-Euclidean Eq axiom imply symmetry and transitivity; predicate congruence descends E, Inc and G. Only V,C are directly quotiented.

checks.name: fixed_q
checks.finding: Ground d has code zero, so rho([d])=d. Therefore reconstructed N(d,d) is exactly the old class [N(d,d)], preserving the selector used by R and D*.

checks.name: class_constructors
checks.finding: N and A outputs satisfy their exact incidence profiles by raw clauses at least representatives. Q is reconstructed at representatives of its two arguments, and raw clauses08/09 give its existential profile using preserved C. No invalid N/A/Q congruence inference occurs.

checks.name: W_witness
checks.finding: In reconstructed row09, the representative triple (rho(s),rho(j),rho(a)) is exactly the triple used by the raw W instance, so the witness class is the reconstructed W value.

checks.name: H_Y_Z_joint_key
checks.finding: Each fixed pair (b,t) uses one representative pair (b0,t0). H,Y,Z raw values therefore retain their shared branch key across rows10-15; all R occurrences use only preserved C and the fixed q-class.

checks.name: nested_D_star
checks.finding: The rebuilt core proves nonempty x implies E(D*_rebuilt(x),x). If x is empty in the quotient, the raw D* literal is false regardless of its value, and the raw row14 yields the required closure. Raw and rebuilt D* need not agree, and the proof does not assert agreement.

checks.name: FC16_extensionality
checks.finding: The proof derives quotient E extensionality from the raw nested Q/N/A incidence profiles, using a selector fresh from d and q. It then uses rebuilt core profiles to derive the actual rebuilt native clause. It does not identify raw nested constructor terms with reconstructed evaluations.

checks.name: finite_stages
checks.finding: The radix16/Cantor interval is subterm-closed. Label equality realizes the finite Eq equivalence and predicate completion; the two same-tag function checks exactly enforce the retained V,C rows. Native endpoint-bounded instances cover all ground native clauses in the limit.

minor_wording_suggestion: Use “the construction retains congruence only for V,C” rather than implying the retained set is proved necessary or minimal.
